caption: The drawing depicts a single, blue glass compote or goblet on a plain, light beige background. The bowl is round, wide, and shallow, with a smooth and reflective surface. Its rim is slightly thickened and circular. The stem is notable for being sculpted in the shape of a human hand grasping the upper part of the column. The base is broad, circular, and ribbed vertically, providing stability for the object. The blue color of the glass is consistent throughout the entire piece, with shading and reflections indicating its translucent and glossy nature. There are no other objects or decorative elements in the background, centering full attention on the glass vessel.
title: Blue Compote
